recommendation: Resolve both findings and re-review exact revised bytes before WBS build.

findings.claim: The final acceptance projection has an unclosed cross-artifact revocation race: it re-reads P16 authority and revocation state before a version-guarded execution-ledger write, but defines no atomic guard over the authority source, so a revocation committed after that read and before the write can still persist ACCEPTED despite the categorical no-write claim.
findings.disposition_reason: Confirmed final acceptance projection lacks atomic revocation guarding and overstates the no-write guarantee.

findings.claim: ADMIN_LEDGER_GENESIS cannot simultaneously honor its fixed allowance of one deterministic invocation and obtain the required independent post-write strict-validator/fixture verification before the administrative ledger is accepted; the design defines no pre-ledger authorization or accounting path for that additional independent activity.
findings.disposition_reason: Confirmed one-call genesis allowance cannot include independent post-write verification.

residual_risks: Acceptance authority TOCTOU and pre-ledger genesis verification remain incomplete until revision.
